span.p:
Eviction process:
1. Clock hand starts at current position
2. If R=1: set R=0, advance hand (second chance)
3. If R=0: evict this entry
4. Repeat until an evictable entry is found
Hand may make full rotation before evicting anything
In worst case: all entries have R=1 (full scan + reset = 2 scans)
Memory per entry: 1 bit (reference bit) + overhead of linked list
Typically 10-20 bytes per entry total
